IX.5 p136v.text: But we need not say more upon this Point, and if what we have here laid down appears to be true, we may conclude Beauty to be such a Consent and Agreement of the Parts of a Whole in which it is found, as to Number, Finishing and Collocation, as Congruity, that is to say, the principal Law of Nature requires. This is what Architecture chiefly aims at, and by this she obtains her Beauty, Dignity and Value.
